description:
Hushfacebook v0.12.0 targets Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This release brings 88 patches. New switches leave calls and chat notifications to Messenger, keep the top bar and the tab bar on screen while you scroll, let a tap on a reel's progress bar seek, and take Muse out of the share sheet. The settings home page gets Quick setups and Report a problem, and a change that needs a restart shows a row that restarts Facebook and returns to the same page. You can name the patched app when you patch and open Facebook's App icon page from Pick an app icon. The kept progress bar shows on every reel and stays where you drag it, and the release notes map each reported issue this release touches.

Validation: 2757 runtime tests passed locally. All 932 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 88 patches applied to Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, build 475417104, or its 32-bit build 475417036. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
